page.overview:
Who is Moray Eel Devil?

The |Utsubo no Akuma}} is a Devil that embodies the concept of moray eels.

The Moray Eel Devil has a long, twisted, segmented body that looks like stacked, exposed muscle rings, with a hollow inner body. A deep slit along its length reveals rows of sharp, interlocking teeth. Its head resembles a monstrous eel with large eyes and several finger-like appendages.

Little is known about the Moray Eel Devil's personality, except that it has some fondness for Yoru, who considers it a friend.

Yoru deploys the Moray Eel Devil from Hell to battle Pochita, only for it to be sliced into pieces. While fighting Yoru, Denji reveals that he constructed an improvised suit of armor using the heads of Yoru’s allies, including the Moray Eel Devil. When Yoru fires at Denji, the attack instead strikes the Moray Eel Devil along with Denji. Denji then immediately consumes it, doing so deliberately to further provoke and emotionally wound Yoru.
